segments.title: certainty and recognition
segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment by Codex, reconciled from independent Tibetan-first and English-first proposals; not human-approved. nges shes/definite conclusion and drongs pa/reach retain separate positive HGM exponents; nges/definite is a tighter member. The complete sgro 'dogs chod pa idiom owns analyze at d3: removing imputations is recast as analytical activity. The positive chod pa/analyze variant alone does not decide this idiom's local scope; both original isolated-word proposals are superseded. The nominal contribution of sgro 'dogs is included in the complete phrase, not assigned to object or to rhetorical implying. Supplied an object and about something remain unwrapped. The EM comparator supports only the shared analytical idiom, not an imported translation. Both thal occurrences own only implying, leaving supplied address and auxiliaries outside. Both med/never, de dag/these and gcig/one/another occurrences have distinct owners; the later beings is an antecedent expansion. phan tshun is distributed in the reciprocal one/another construction and is omitted, not nulled. The first 'dod pa'i phyir is distributed without a separate defended English atom; the final 'dod pa/position and phyir/given are retained. 'dod na owns if so at d3. All original source wording is preserved.
